-- Module:Infobox -- The engine behind {{Infobox character}}, {{Infobox organization}} and -- {{Infobox event}}. Each template calls one function here; the fields, -- sections, badges, categories and short descriptions are all defined in -- TYPES below, so a layout change happens in one place. local p = {} local plain -- defined under Helpers; used by the short descriptions -- =================================================================== -- Settings you may want to change -- =================================================================== -- The `version` field: category name and how it is shown. %s is the version. local VERSION_CATEGORY = "Let's RP %s" local VERSION_LABEL = "Let's RP %s" -- Pages with a missing or unknown value in a checked field go here, so they -- can be found and fixed. Only articles are categorised, never templates. local ERROR_CATEGORY = 'Pages with infobox problems' -- How many portraits an infobox takes: image, image2 … image5. local MAX_IMAGES = 5 -- Width the pictures are sent at (the infobox scales them to fit). local IMAGE_WIDTH = '400px' -- Shown when an infobox has no picture. Upload it once as File:Image unavailable.png; -- until it exists, infoboxes without a picture simply show none. Set to nil to turn off. local PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE = 'Image unavailable.png' -- =================================================================== -- The three infoboxes -- =================================================================== -- badges: checked fields shown as coloured pills under the title, each a -- link to its category. values maps what people type (lower case) -- to how it shows; category gives the category for a value. -- link: on a field, plain names typed into it become links: -- "Big Rig Customs" -> [[Big Rig Customs]]. Lists split on commas. -- kicker: the small line above the title. -- sections: groups of rows. The first has no title and is always open; -- the rest fold. `when` hides a whole section unless it's true. local TYPES = {} TYPES.character = { kind = 'Character', badges = { { field = 'status', required = true, values = { active = 'Active', inactive = 'Inactive', deceased = 'Deceased' }, category = function (label) return label .. ' characters' end }, { field = 'focus', required = true, values = { civilian = 'Civilian', criminal = 'Criminal', ['public sector'] = 'Public Sector' }, category = function (label) return label .. ' characters' end }, }, sections = { { fields = { { 'full_name', 'Full name' }, { 'nicknames', 'Nicknames' }, { 'date_of_birth', 'Date of birth' }, { 'gender', 'Gender' }, { 'nationality', 'Nationality' }, } }, { title = 'Life', fields = { { 'occupation', 'Occupation' }, { 'employer', 'Employer', link = true }, { 'affiliation', 'Affiliation', link = true }, { 'rank', 'Rank' }, { 'residence', 'Residence' }, { 'phone', 'Phone number' }, } }, { title = 'Relationships', fields = { { 'family', 'Family', link = true }, { 'partner', 'Partner', link = true }, } }, { title = 'Death', when = function (v) return v.status == 'deceased' end, fields = { { 'died', 'Died' }, { 'cause_of_death', 'Cause of death' }, { 'killed_by', 'Killed by', link = true }, } }, { title = 'Meta', fields = { { 'played_by', 'Played by' }, { 'first_seen', 'First seen' }, { 'last_seen', 'Last seen' }, { 'version', 'Server version', version = true }, } }, }, categories = function (v) local c = { 'Characters' } if v.status then table.insert(c, v.statusLabel .. ' characters') end if v.focus then table.insert(c, v.focusLabel .. ' characters') end return c end, shortdesc = function (v) -- e.g. "Criminal character", "Deceased civilian character" local focus = v.focusLabel and (v.focusLabel .. ' character') or 'Character' if v.status and v.status ~= 'active' then return v.statusLabel .. ' ' .. mw.ustring.lower(focus) end return focus end, -- An inactive character shows when they were last seen, under the badges. note = function (v, args) if v.status == 'inactive' and args.last_seen then return 'Last seen ' .. args.last_seen end end, } TYPES.organization = { kind = function (v, args) -- "Gang", or "Police · Emergency Services" when a subtype is given if args.subtype and v.typeLabel then return args.subtype .. ' · ' .. v.typeLabel end return args.subtype or v.typeLabel or 'Organization' end, badges = { { field = 'type', required = true, hidden = true, values = { gang = 'Gang', business = 'Business', ['emergency services'] = 'Emergency Services', emergency = 'Emergency Services', ['emergency service'] = 'Emergency Services' } }, { field = 'status', values = { active = 'Active', inactive = 'Inactive', defunct = 'Defunct' }, category = function (label) return label .. ' organizations' end }, }, sections = { { fields = { { 'leader', 'Leader', link = true }, { 'founded', 'Founded' }, { 'founder', 'Founder', link = true }, { 'defunct', 'Defunct' }, { 'headquarters', 'Headquarters' }, { 'members', 'Members' }, } }, { title = 'Gang', when = function (v) return v.type == 'gang' end, fields = { { 'territory', 'Territory' }, { 'colours', 'Colours' }, { 'activities', 'Activities' }, } }, { title = 'Business', when = function (v) return v.type == 'business' end, fields = { { 'industry', 'Industry' }, { 'services', 'Products & services' }, { 'owner', 'Owner', link = true }, { 'location', 'Location' }, { 'hours', 'Opening hours' }, { 'phone', 'Phone number' }, } }, { title = 'Emergency Services', when = function (v) return v.type == 'emergency services' end, fields = { { 'jurisdiction', 'Jurisdiction' }, { 'divisions', 'Divisions' }, { 'ranks', 'Ranks' }, } }, { title = 'Relations', fields = { { 'allies', 'Allies', link = true }, { 'rivals', 'Rivals', link = true }, { 'predecessor', 'Predecessor', link = true }, { 'successor', 'Successor', link = true }, } }, { title = 'Meta', fields = { { 'first_seen', 'First seen' }, { 'last_seen', 'Last seen' }, { 'version', 'Server version', version = true }, } }, }, categories = function (v) local plural = { gang = 'Gangs', business = 'Businesses', ['emergency services'] = 'Emergency Services' } local c = { 'Organizations' } if v.type then table.insert(c, plural[v.type]) end if v.status then table.insert(c, v.statusLabel .. ' organizations') end return c end, shortdesc = function (v, args) local what = args.subtype or v.typeLabel or 'Organization' if v.status == 'defunct' then return 'Former ' .. mw.ustring.lower(what) end return what end, } TYPES.event = { kind = function (v) return v.typeLabel or 'Event' end, badges = { { field = 'type', required = true, values = { heist = 'Heist', ['gang war'] = 'Gang war', shooting = 'Shooting', trial = 'Trial', election = 'Election', ['community event'] = 'Community event', ['official server event'] = 'Official server event', official = 'Official server event', other = 'Other' }, category = function (label) local plural = { ['Gang war'] = 'Gang wars', ['Community event'] = 'Community events', ['Official server event'] = 'Official server events', Other = 'Other events' } return plural[label] or (label .. 's') end }, }, sections = { { fields = { { 'date', 'Date' }, { 'end_date', 'Ended' }, { 'location', 'Location' }, { 'organised_by', 'Organised by', link = true }, } }, { title = 'Who', fields = { { 'participants', 'Participants', link = true }, { 'factions', 'Factions involved', link = true }, } }, { title = 'Outcome', fields = { { 'outcome', 'Outcome' }, { 'casualties', 'Casualties' }, { 'arrests', 'Arrests' }, } }, { title = 'Timeline', fields = { { 'previous', 'Previous event', link = true }, { 'next', 'Next event', link = true }, } }, { title = 'Meta', fields = { { 'media', 'Clips & media' }, { 'version', 'Server version', version = true }, } }, }, categories = function (v) local plural = { heist = 'Heists', ['gang war'] = 'Gang wars', shooting = 'Shootings', trial = 'Trials', election = 'Elections', ['community event'] = 'Community events', ['official server event'] = 'Official server events', other = 'Other events', } local c = { 'Events' } if v.type then table.insert(c, plural[v.type]) end return c end, shortdesc = function (v, args) local what = v.typeLabel or 'Event' if args.date then return what .. ' on ' .. plain(args.date) end return what end, } -- =================================================================== -- Helpers -- =================================================================== local function clean(s) if s == nil then return nil end s = mw.text.trim(s) if s == '' then return nil end return s end -- Text without wiki markup, for the short description. plain = function (s) s = s or '' s = s:gsub('%[%[[^%]|]-|([^%]]-)%]%]', '%1') -- [[Target|label]] -> label s = s:gsub('%[%[([^%]]-)%]%]', '%1') -- [[Target]] -> Target s = s:gsub('%[https?://%S+%s+([^%]]-)%]', '%1') -- [url label] -> label s = s:gsub("'''?", '') s = s:gsub('<[^>]->', '') return mw.text.trim(s) end -- Canonical value for a checked field: the key (lower case) and its label. -- Returns nil, nil, typed when it isn't one of the allowed values. local function pick(badge, typed) if not typed then return nil, nil, nil end local key = mw.ustring.lower(plain(typed)) local label = badge.values[key] if not label then return nil, nil, typed end -- Aliases ("emergency") share a label; the key is always the label in lower case. return mw.ustring.lower(label), label, nil end local function cssKey(s) return (mw.ustring.lower(s):gsub('[^%w]+', '-')) end -- Words that mean "nobody / not known" and should never become links. local NO_LINK = { unknown = true, none = true, ['n/a'] = true, na = true, various = true, nobody = true, ['no one'] = true, tbd = true, tba = true, unemployed = true, independent = true, ['self-employed'] = true, self = true, ['?'] = true, ['-'] = true, ['–'] = true, ['—'] = true, } -- Turn plain names into links: "Big Rig Customs" -> [[Big Rig Customs]]. -- Lists split on commas, semicolons and lines; "Rosa Ramirez (mother)" keeps -- its note outside the link. Anything already containing markup is left as typed. local function autolink(value) if value:find('[%[%]{}<>|]') or value:find("''", 1, true) then return value end local lines = {} for line in mw.text.gsplit(value, '\n') do local bullet, rest = line:match('^([%*#:]*%s*)(.*)$') local items = {} for item in mw.text.gsplit(rest, '[,;]') do item = mw.text.trim(item) if item ~= '' then local name, note = item:match('^(.-)%s*(%b())$') if not name or name == '' then name, note = item, nil end local skip = NO_LINK[mw.ustring.lower(name)] or name:match('^[%d%s%p]+$') or not mw.title.new(name) local linked = skip and name or ('[[' .. name .. ']]') table.insert(items, note and (linked .. ' ' .. note) or linked) end end table.insert(lines, bullet .. table.concat(items, ', ')) end return table.concat(lines, '\n') end -- A value that starts with a list needs a newline to render as a list. local function block(s) if s:match('^[%*#:;]') then return '\n' .. s .. '\n' end return s end local function fileLink(name, caption, class) if name:match('^%[%[') then return name end name = name:gsub('^[Ff]ile:', ''):gsub('^[Ii]mage:', '') return string.format('[[File:%s|%s|alt=%s%s]]', name, IMAGE_WIDTH, caption or '', class and ('|class=' .. class) or '') end -- Is the placeholder uploaded? (Checked once per page.) local function placeholderExists() if not PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE then return false end local t = mw.title.new(PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE, 'File') return t ~= nil and t.file ~= nil and t.file.exists end -- =================================================================== -- Building the infobox -- =================================================================== local function render(frame, typeName) local def = TYPES[typeName] local args = {} for k, v in pairs(frame:getParent().args) do args[k] = clean(v) end local title = mw.title.getCurrentTitle() local isArticle = title.namespace == 0 local name = args.name or title.text -- Read the checked fields. local v = {} local problems = {} for _, badge in ipairs(def.badges) do local key, label, bad = pick(badge, args[badge.field]) v[badge.field] = key v[badge.field .. 'Label'] = label if bad then table.insert(problems, string.format('“%s” isn’t a known %s', bad, badge.field)) elseif badge.required and not key then table.insert(problems, string.format('%s is missing', badge.field)) end end local box = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('rp-infobox'):addClass('rp-infobox--' .. typeName) for _, badge in ipairs(def.badges) do if v[badge.field] then box:addClass('rp-' .. badge.field .. '--' .. cssKey(v[badge.field])) end end -- Pictures: one, or several as tabs. local images = {} for i = 1, MAX_IMAGES do local suffix = i == 1 and '' or tostring(i) local file = args['image' .. suffix] if file then table.insert(images, { file = file, label = args['image' .. suffix .. '_label'] or (i == 1 and 'Main' or ('Image ' .. i)), caption = args['caption' .. suffix], }) end end if #images == 0 and placeholderExists() then -- No picture given: the placeholder, kept out of search thumbnails (notpageimage). box:tag('div'):addClass('rp-ib-image'):addClass('rp-ib-placeholder') :wikitext(string.format('[[File:%s|%s|alt=No image|link=|class=notpageimage]]', PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE, IMAGE_WIDTH)) elseif #images == 1 then local fig = box:tag('div'):addClass('rp-ib-image') fig:wikitext(fileLink(images[1].file, images[1].caption)) if images[1].caption then fig:tag('div'):addClass('rp-ib-caption'):wikitext(images[1].caption) end elseif #images > 1 then local tabs = {} for _, img in ipairs(images) do local content = fileLink(img.file, img.caption) if img.caption then content = content .. '
' .. img.caption .. '
' end table.insert(tabs, '|-|' .. img.label:gsub('=', '') .. '=' .. content) end box:tag('div'):addClass('rp-ib-image'):addClass('rp-ib-tabs') :wikitext(frame:extensionTag('tabber', table.concat(tabs, '\n'))) end -- Heading: kind, name, badges. local head = box:tag('div'):addClass('rp-ib-head') local kind = type(def.kind) == 'function' and def.kind(v, args) or def.kind head:tag('div'):addClass('rp-ib-kind'):wikitext(kind) head:tag('div'):addClass('rp-ib-title'):wikitext(name) local pills = {} for _, badge in ipairs(def.badges) do if v[badge.field] and not badge.hidden then local label = v[badge.field .. 'Label'] -- Each badge links to its category, e.g. "Criminal" -> Category:Criminal characters. local text = badge.category and string.format('[[:Category:%s|%s]]', badge.category(label), label) or label table.insert(pills, { badge.field, v[badge.field], text }) end end if #pills > 0 then local row = head:tag('div'):addClass('rp-ib-badges') for _, b in ipairs(pills) do row:tag('span'):addClass('rp-badge'):addClass('rp-badge--' .. cssKey(b[2])):wikitext(b[3]) end end local note = def.note and def.note(v, args) if note then head:tag('div'):addClass('rp-ib-note'):wikitext(note) end -- Sections of rows. for i, section in ipairs(def.sections) do if not section.when or section.when(v) then local rows = {} for _, f in ipairs(section.fields) do local value = args[f[1]] if value then if f.version then value = string.format(VERSION_LABEL, value) end if f.link then value = autolink(value) end table.insert(rows, { f[2], value }) end end if #rows > 0 then local sec = box:tag('div'):addClass('rp-ib-section') local body = sec if section.title then sec:addClass('mw-collapsible') sec:tag('div'):addClass('rp-ib-section-title'):addClass('mw-collapsible-toggle'):wikitext(section.title) body = sec:tag('div'):addClass('mw-collapsible-content') end for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local row = body:tag('div'):addClass('rp-ib-row') row:tag('div'):addClass('rp-ib-label'):wikitext(r[1]) row:tag('div'):addClass('rp-ib-value'):wikitext(block(r[2])) end end end end -- Problems show in the box itself, so whoever sees them can fix them. if #problems > 0 then local warn = box:tag('div'):addClass('rp-ib-problems') warn:wikitext('Infobox: ' .. table.concat(problems, '; ') .. '. See the template’s page for the allowed values.') end local out = { frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:Infobox/styles.css' }), tostring(box) } -- Short description: the grey line under the page title. local desc = args.shortdesc or def.shortdesc(v, args) if args.version and not args.shortdesc then desc = desc .. ' in ' .. string.format(VERSION_LABEL, args.version) end if isArticle and desc and desc ~= '' then table.insert(out, frame:preprocess('{{SHORTDESC:' .. plain(desc) .. '}}')) end -- Categories, on articles only. if isArticle then local cats = def.categories(v, args) if args.version then table.insert(cats, string.format(VERSION_CATEGORY, args.version)) end if #problems > 0 then table.insert(cats, ERROR_CATEGORY) end for _, c in ipairs(cats) do table.insert(out, '[[Category:' .. c .. ']]') end end return table.concat(out) end function p.character(frame) return render(frame, 'character') end function p.organization(frame) return render(frame, 'organization') end function p.event(frame) return render(frame, 'event') end -- For the documentation pages: the allowed values of a checked field, -- e.g. {{#invoke:Infobox|values|character|status}}. function p.values(frame) local def = TYPES[frame.args[1]] if not def then return '' end for _, badge in ipairs(def.badges) do if badge.field == frame.args[2] then local seen, list = {}, {} for _, label in pairs(badge.values) do if not seen[label] then seen[label] = true; table.insert(list, label) end end table.sort(list) return table.concat(list, ' · ') end end return '' end return p

For a character. Shows their status and focus as badges, sorts the page into categories, and writes the grey line under the title. The fields, sections and look are shared by all infoboxes and live in [[Module:Infobox]] and [[Template:Infobox/styles.css]]. == Copy and paste == 
{{Infobox character
| name           =
| image          =
| caption        =
| status         =
| focus          =
| full_name      =
| nicknames      =
| date_of_birth  =
| gender         =
| nationality    =
| occupation     =
| employer       =
| affiliation    =
| rank           =
| residence      =
| phone          =
| family         =
| partner        =
| died           =
| cause_of_death =
| killed_by      =
| played_by      =
| first_seen     =
| last_seen      =
| version        =
}}
Empty fields don't show. Extra pictures (image2 … image5) turn into tabs. In fields that name people, groups or events (employer, affiliation, family, leader, rivals, participants…), plain names become links: Big Rig Customs shows as [[Big Rig Customs]]. Separate several with commas; a note in brackets stays outside the link (Rosa Ramirez (mother)). Words like ''Unknown'' or ''None'', numbers, and anything that already has links or other markup are left as typed. The status, focus and type badges link to their categories. == Checked fields == These only take certain values. Anything else is listed in [[:Category:Pages with infobox problems]]. {| class="wikitable" ! Field !! Allowed values !! Required |- | status || {{#invoke:Infobox|values|character|status}} || yes |- | focus || {{#invoke:Infobox|values|character|focus}} || yes |- |} == All fields == {| class="wikitable" ! Field !! Shows as !! Notes |- | name || Name || Shown as the infobox title. Leave empty to use the page title. |- | image || Image || File name of the main picture, e.g. Tony.png (no File: needed). |- | caption || Caption || Text under the main picture. |- | image_label || Image tab label || Tab name for the main picture when there are several, e.g. 2025. |- | image2 || Image 2 || Another picture: they become tabs. image3 … image5 work the same way. |- | caption2 || Caption 2 || Text under image 2. |- | image2_label || Image 2 tab label || Tab name for image 2. |- | status || Status || Active, Inactive (the player has stopped playing them, but they are alive) or Deceased. |- | focus || Focus || What the character is currently focused on: Civilian, Criminal or Public Sector. |- | full_name || Full name || |- | nicknames || Nicknames || |- | date_of_birth || Date of birth || |- | gender || Gender || |- | nationality || Nationality || |- | occupation || Occupation || |- | employer || Employer || Link to an organization. |- | affiliation || Affiliation || Gangs or organizations, as links. |- | rank || Rank || Their position in that organization. |- | residence || Residence || |- | phone || Phone number || In-character number. |- | family || Family || |- | partner || Partner || |- | died || Died || Only shown when status is Deceased. |- | cause_of_death || Cause of death || Only shown when status is Deceased. |- | killed_by || Killed by || Only shown when status is Deceased. |- | played_by || Played by || The player. |- | first_seen || First seen || |- | last_seen || Last seen || Also shown under the badges when the character is Inactive. |- | version || Server version || Which version of the server, e.g. 2.0. Adds the category Let's RP 2.0. |- | shortdesc || Short description || Replaces the automatic grey line under the page title. |- |} == Example == 
{{Infobox character
| status         = Active
| focus          = Criminal
| full_name      = Antonio "Tony" Ramirez
| nicknames      = Two-Times
| date_of_birth  = 3 March 1992
| gender         = Male
| nationality    = American
| occupation     = Mechanic
| employer       = [[Big Rig Customs]]
| affiliation    = [[Southside Saints]]
| rank           = Soldier
| residence      = Grove Street
| phone          = 555-0142
| played_by      = TwoTimesTony
| first_seen     = March 2026
| version        = 2.0
}}
== Start a new page with this infobox == Put this box on a page (for example a directory page) to let people start a new article with the infobox and section headings already filled in: 

type=create
preload=Template:Infobox character/preload
buttonlabel=Create a page
placeholder=Page title

For a gang, a business or an emergency service. The type decides which extra section shows. The fields, sections and look are shared by all infoboxes and live in [[Module:Infobox]] and [[Template:Infobox/styles.css]]. == Copy and paste == 
{{Infobox organization
| name         =
| image        =
| caption      =
| type         =
| subtype      =
| status       =
| leader       =
| founded      =
| founder      =
| defunct      =
| headquarters =
| members      =
| territory    =
| colours      =
